How to register

  1. Install the Astrowani Astrologer app from Google Play.
  2. Open the app and fill in the registration form: your name, mobile number, experience, languages and skills.
  3. Our team reviews every profile before an astrologer can take consultations.
  4. Once you are approved, go online in the app and start taking chat and call consultations.

Ready to start?

Looking for an astrologer instead?

The Astrologer app is only for astrologers. To consult an astrologer, use the Astrowani app or browse astrologer profiles on this website.

Need help?

If you have trouble registering, write to support@astrowani.com with your registered mobile number and a short description of the problem.
